dialogues.jp: 手を伸ばし、スイッチを押す。
dialogues.en: I reached out my arm to turn the alarm off.
dialogues.text: I reached out my arm to turn the alarm off.

dialogues.jp: 軽くのびをすると、すぐさま着替えを始める。
dialogues.en: I stretched lightly, and then got dressed.
dialogues.text: I stretched lightly, and then got dressed.

dialogues.jp: 今日も｛あわただ／慌｝しい朝だ。
dialogues.en: It's a busy morning as usual.
dialogues.text: It's a busy morning as usual.

dialogues.jp:
音夢が数十分前に歩いたであろう同じ道を、少
し早めに歩きながら、学園に向かう。
dialogues.en:
I walked quickly on the way to school. Nemu must have been
there a half an hour ago.
dialogues.text:
I walked quickly on the way to school. Nemu must have been
there a half an hour ago.

dialogues.jp:
同じ道を歩く学生の数は、ピークの時間を過ぎ
てまばらだ。
dialogues.en: There weren't many students on the street anymore.
dialogues.text: There weren't many students on the street anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「もう、お姉ちゃんっ！　あと少しだから早
　く！」
dialogues.en: "Oneechan, hurry!"
dialogues.text: "Oneechan, hurry!"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「あふぅ……眞子ちゃん……待ってください」
dialogues.en: "Huff, puff...... Mako-chan......wait for me......"
dialogues.text: "Huff, puff...... Mako-chan......wait for me......"

dialogues.jp: おや？　この声は……。
dialogues.en: Hm? These voices sound familiar......
dialogues.text: Hm? These voices sound familiar......

dialogues.jp:
後ろをフイ――と振り向くと、数メートル先と
１０数メートル先に見知った顔があった。
dialogues.en: I turned around -- and saw familiar faces a few feet away.
dialogues.text: I turned around -- and saw familiar faces a few feet away.

dialogues.jp: 「ようっ」
dialogues.en: "Hey guys."
dialogues.text: "Hey guys."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Hm?"
dialogues.text: "Hm?"

dialogues.jp: まずは比較的、側にいた眞子に声をかける。
dialogues.en:
I said hello to Mak,o who was a little closer to me than
Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text:
I said hello to Mak,o who was a little closer to me than
Moe-sempai.

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「げっ、朝倉。お姉ちゃんホントに早く！　遅
　刻寸前ッ！」
dialogues.en:
"Oh no, Asakura. Hurry up, oneechan! We're really in danger
of being late!"
dialogues.text:
"Oh no, Asakura. Hurry up, oneechan! We're really in danger
of being late!"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: (......Heeeey.)
dialogues.text: (......Heeeey.)

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと待てコラ。なんだ今の反応は？」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「あんたがここにいるってことは、遅刻寸前っ
　てことでしょうが」
dialogues.en:
"If you're here, that means we must really be close to being
late."
dialogues.text:
"If you're here, that means we must really be close to being
late."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「それとも、もうチャイム鳴っちゃった！？」
dialogues.en: "---! Or are we already late?!?"
dialogues.text: "---! Or are we already late?!?"

dialogues.jp: シメるぞコラ。
dialogues.en: That's an insult.
dialogues.text: That's an insult.

dialogues.jp: 「時計をよく見てみろ。まだ大丈夫だ」
dialogues.en: "Look at your watch. We're not late yet."
dialogues.text: "Look at your watch. We're not late yet."

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.en: "Really?"
dialogues.text: "Really?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「あ、ホントだ」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah."
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah."

dialogues.jp:
携帯を取り出して時間を確認した眞子が不思議
そうに呟く。
dialogues.en:
She checked the time on her cellular phone and mumbled to
herself.
dialogues.text:
She checked the time on her cellular phone and mumbled to
herself.

dialogues.jp:
「それにしても、なんでお前が萌先輩の木琴を
　持ってるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Why are you carrying Moe-sempai's xylophone?"
dialogues.text: "Why are you carrying Moe-sempai's xylophone?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「だってこれ持たせてたら、叩き始めちゃって
　余計遅くなっちゃうから」
dialogues.en:
"Because if I give this to her, she'll start playing it
right away, and we'll be even more late."
dialogues.text:
"Because if I give this to her, she'll start playing it
right away, and we'll be even more late."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp:
「あ……く……くん……おひゃよう……ござい
　ます……」

息も絶え絶えの萌先輩が俺と眞子に追いつき、
クーラーボックスを抱えたまま、その場にクタ
クタと座り込む。
dialogues.en:
Moe-sempai was catching her breath, and sat down on a cooler
box she had been carrying.
dialogues.text:
Moe-sempai was catching her breath, and sat down on a cooler
box she had been carrying.

dialogues.jp: 「かわいそうに……」
dialogues.en: "Poor her......"
dialogues.text: "Poor her......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「気になる言い方ね」
dialogues.en: "What's that supposed to mean?"
dialogues.text: "What's that supposed to mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp: 「まあ、細かいことは気にするな」
dialogues.en: "Don't sweat it on the small things."
dialogues.text: "Don't sweat it on the small things."

dialogues.jp: 眞子に答えつつ萌先輩の前にしゃがみ込む。
dialogues.en: I replied to Mako, bending over to Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I replied to Mako, bending over to Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: 「先輩、大丈夫ですか？」
dialogues.en: "Are you alright?"
dialogues.text: "Are you alright?"

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「はぁはぁ……は、はい、大丈夫です……」

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「持ちましょうか、それ？」
dialogues.en: "Shall I carry that for you?"
dialogues.text: "Shall I carry that for you?"

dialogues.jp: 俺はクーラーボックスに触れる。
dialogues.en: I pointed at the cooler box.
dialogues.text: I pointed at the cooler box.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「いえ……大丈夫です。今日は軽いですから」
dialogues.en: "No...... It's okay. It's quite light today."
dialogues.text: "No...... It's okay. It's quite light today."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「そうですか？」
dialogues.en: "Oh yeah?"
dialogues.text: "Oh yeah?"

dialogues.jp: 立ち上がり、萌先輩に手を差し出す。
dialogues.en: I stood up straight, and offered my hand to her.
dialogues.text: I stood up straight, and offered my hand to her.

dialogues.jp:
ほっそりとした手が俺の手の中にすっぽりと包
まれる。走ってきたせいか、萌先輩の手はにわ
かに暖かく感じられた。
dialogues.en:
Her soft hand was placed in mine. It was hot as she had been
running.
dialogues.text:
Her soft hand was placed in mine. It was hot as she had been
running.

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.jp: 「どうも、ありがとうございます」
dialogues.en: "Thank you very much."
dialogues.text: "Thank you very much."

dialogues.speaker: Moe
dialogues.en: "No problem......"
dialogues.text: "No problem......"

dialogues.speaker: Mako
dialogues.jp:
「時間あるみたいだし、こっからは歩いていこ
　う」
dialogues.en: "It looks like we have enough time - let's walk from here."
dialogues.text: "It looks like we have enough time - let's walk from here."

dialogues.jp: 眞子の言葉を合図に、歩き始める。
dialogues.en: We began walking together as Mako suggested.
dialogues.text: We began walking together as Mako suggested.

dialogues.jp:
自然と眞子と萌先輩に挟まれる形となり、学園
に向かう。
dialogues.en: I headed to school walking between Mako and Moe-sempai.
dialogues.text: I headed to school walking between Mako and Moe-sempai.

dialogues.jp: 遅く起きても、いいことはあるもんだ……。
dialogues.en: Sometimes good things happen when you get up late......
dialogues.text: Sometimes good things happen when you get up late......

dialogues.jp: ◆萌と眞子に会う◆
dialogues.en: ◆Moe and Mako◆
dialogues.text: ◆Moe and Mako◆

dialogues.jp: 通学の途中、眞子と萌先輩に出会った。
dialogues.en: I ran into Mako and Moe-sempai on the way to school.
dialogues.text: I ran into Mako and Moe-sempai on the way to school.

dialogues.jp:
両手に花というか。遅く起きても、良いことは
あるものだ……。
dialogues.en:
It was nice to have girls on both sides. Sometimes good
things happen when you get up late......
dialogues.text:
It was nice to have girls on both sides. Sometimes good
things happen when you get up late......
